translation.title: Insect Bites and Itching Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain, and for itchy skin, insect bites and chilblains.
translation.usage: Apply the patch to the affected area 1 to several times a day as appropriate.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: hypersensitivity to this medicine. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the eyes or the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas; sensitive skin. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; people with a circulatory disorder or diabetes; children aged 12 years or under. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it by mouth or inhale it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water. If the symptoms are severe, seek treatment from an ophthalmologist. Hands with the medicine on them can irritate the eyes and other mucous membranes, so wash the medicine off your hands thoroughly. Do not cover or wrap the application site, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If water touches the area where the medicine was applied, you may feel strong irritation. People with particularly delicate skin must not use it continuously on the same area. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; swelling; itching; pain. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep the lid tightly closed.
